data.content_ref: inline:The target's mechanism is circular: it purports to justify the claim but instead restates the claim itself as its own ground. The mechanism says 'The reason this holds is that [the preference is defensible only if reinterpreted through an evolutionary epistemology ...], which is what the mechanism above establishes.' The clause that is supposed to supply the reason is simply the original claim echoed back, making the argument self-grounding rather than independently supported. A circular mechanism cannot establish the strong 'only if' exclusivity the claim asserts; it merely asserts it twice.
